finding_key: packages/backend/src/api/v1/docs-content.controller.ts::new slide-inline guard accepts an inline with no `style`; every downstream reader dereferences `inline.style` unconditionally, so such a stored inline crashes canvas layout and pptx export for every viewer
evidence: assertValidSlideInlines (docs-content.controller.ts) only rejects a present non-object style — `{ text: 'x' }` with no style passes, unlike the docs arm which requires an object style. In packages/slides/src/export/pptx/text.ts, runToXml passes inline.style straight into rPrXml, whose first statement `if (s.bold)` throws a TypeError when style is undefined; slides bodies are persisted verbatim with no read-side normalizer (per the controller's own comments), so the stored inline crashes PPTX export for every viewer. The layout.ts:777 citation could not be verified (file not supplied), but the exporter crash alone confirms the defect.
